title: Jacob Collier Explains Music in 5 Levels of Difficulty ft. Herbie Hancock | WIRED
summary: WIRED's 5 Levels format with Jacob Collier explaining harmony to a child, a teen, a college student, a professional and Herbie Hancock.
why: Recommended as a gentle explanation of harmony for beginners and cited as the model of the 'explain at five levels' format.

quote.text: If you really know nothing you might enjoy this attempt at explaining harmony at five different levels from a child to Herbie Hancock
